August - What fantastic vehicles sold!

Featured cars
August was a month to remember at Bidders Highway. Our auctions were buzzing with activity, and countless fantastic enthusiast vehicles found new homes. From timeless classics to modern sports cars, from unique restomod projects to well-preserved originals – the mix has been as diverse as car culture itself. This is automotive passion at its very best.
Tomas JönssonAugust 26, 2025 15:00

Buying at Auction – Safe, Simple, and Thrilling

Many hesitate the first time they consider buying at auction, but that feeling quickly disappears. With us, the process is transparent and secure – bidding happens openly, all relevant information is available, and the market itself sets the price. When the hammer falls, you know the deal has landed at the right level. And the thrill of winning an auction is hard to beat – it’s not just a car purchase, it’s an experience.

Below we list some of the highlights that have been sold recently on our marketplace. Here we find, among other things, a delicious Camaro cab, a top-renovated luxury vehicle in the form of a Bentley S2 Continental and an exciting "No reserve" auction on a BMW 525 tds.

A Growing Community of Enthusiasts

Bidders Highway is more than just a marketplace. We have rapidly grown into one of Scandinavia’s leading auction houses for enthusiast vehicles, and alongside this growth, our community has expanded as well. Here, people who share the same passion come together – whether you’re a collector, a builder, a sports car hunter, or a caretaker of a classic. With us, buyers and sellers meet, but so do enthusiasts who simply want to follow the journey and be inspired.

A low-mileage Nissan 300ZX with only one owner was one of the cars that found a new home during the month of August.

Strong selection thanks to free selling

One of the reasons we can offer such a broad and high-quality selection is that it’s completely free to sell on Bidders Highway. For sellers, that means an easy path to market. For buyers, it means more cars to choose from – dream machines as well as unexpected gems. This dynamic is one of our greatest strengths.

Old Swedish classics in the form of a Saab 93B De Luxe, or German GT icons from completely different time periods - everything is available at Bidders Highway.

High Activity This Fall – Don’t Miss Out

Now autumn is here, but the pace remains high. Enthusiasts are far from finished with this year’s deals – in fact, quite the opposite. Cars are being bought and sold at full speed, making this the perfect time to take the step and experience the excitement of auctions.

To those thinking about buying: take the leap. Buying at auction isn’t risky – it’s fun, secure, and gives you access to some of the most exciting vehicles on the market today.

And to those looking to sell: submit your car now and become part of our growing community. Together, we make Bidders Highway not just a place where automotive passion lives on – but where it grows stronger every month.

//Tomas Jönsson, Bidders Highway
